note: One usable site, FG 001: an open landing at the end of a gravel driveway off Fourth Gap Road, about 0.4 mile from Mile Run Road (3.1 miles from I-80 exit 199); the booking page grades the driveway Moderate. The second site on this road, FG 002, about 1 km further on, posts a 10-ft overhead clearance, too low for a motorhome over that height. Pack out trash. --Claude
